# telnyx_10dlc_brands (Data Source)

Lists 10dlc brands, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_10dlc_brand`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `brand_id` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `entity_type` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-assignedCampaignsCount`, `-brandId`, `-createdAt`, `-displayName`, `-identityStatus`, `-status`, `-tcrBrandId`, `assignedCampaignsCount`, `brandId`, `createdAt`, `displayName`, `identityStatus`, `status`, `tcrBrandId`.
- `state` (String)
- `tcr_brand_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `brands` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--brands))

<a id="nestedatt--brands"></a>
### Nested Schema for `brands`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_campaings_count` (Number) Number of campaigns associated with the brand
- `brand_id` (String) Unique identifier assigned to the brand.
- `company_name` (String) (Required for Non-profit/private/public) Legal company name.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time that the brand was created at.
- `display_name` (String) Display or marketing name of the brand.
- `email` (String) Valid email address of brand support contact.
- `entity_type` (String) Entity type behind the brand. This is the form of business establishment.
- `failure_reasons` (String) Failure reasons for brand
- `identity_status` (String) The verification status of an active brand
- `status` (String) Status of the brand
- `tcr_brand_id` (String) Unique identifier assigned to the brand by the registry.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time that the brand was last updated at.
- `website` (String) Brand website URL.
